text:
[Council File 26-0438; CD 8]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (HARRIS-DAWSON - HUTT) relative to amending the prior Council action of March 27, 2026 regarding the expenses associated with community events in Council District 8 by Purpose Driven Solutions Consulting, LCC under City Contract C-201360.
Recommendation(s) for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
AMEND prior Council action of March 27, 2026 regarding the expenses associated with community events in Council District 8 by Purpose Driven Solutions Consulting, LCC under City Contract C-201360 (Council file No. 26-0438) to:
1. INSTRUCT the City Clerk to reduce the $260,000 allocation to Purpose Driven Solutions Consulting (Contract No. C-201360) from the General City Purposes Fund No. 100-56, Account No. 0708 (CD 8 Community Services) by $225,000 and allocate a like amount therefrom to Asian American Drug Abuse Program, Inc. (Contract No. C-204866) for the management and production of several community events in Council District 8.
2. INSTRUCT and AUTHORIZE the City Clerk to prepare, process and execute the necessary documents with and/or payments to Purpose Driven Solutions Consulting, LLC and Asian American Drug Abuse Program, Inc., or any other agency or organization, as appropriate, utilizing the above amount, for the above purpose, subject to the approval of the City Attorney as to form.
